title: Barrio Brewing Co
specs: Craft beers brewed on site including Blonde Ale, Fruit Ale, German Hefeweizen, Scottish Red Ale, American Pale Ale, Hazy IPA, Grapefruit IPA, Citrus IPA, Coffee Stout, and Porter.

options.name: Loaded Beer Fries
options.detail: Beer fries topped with beer cheese, bacon, and scallions, served with homemade ranch.

options.name: Bavarian Beer Sponges
options.detail: Two handcrafted soft pretzels with butter and salt, served with beer mustard and beer cheese.

options.name: Poutine
options.detail: Crispy beer fries smothered in housemade brown gravy, topped with cheese curds, jalapeño, and bacon.

options.name: Buffalo Wings
options.detail: Made to order wings with sauce options and served with ranch or blue cheese and carrots.

options.name: Southwestern Burger
options.detail: Burger with roasted Hatch green chili and melted pepper jack cheese, topped with avocado tomatillo sauce.

options.name: Diane Burger
options.detail: Burger with sautéed mushrooms and onions in butter, garlic, parsley, and red wine, topped with Swiss cheese.

blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on site along with a menu featuring appetizers, soups, salads, burgers, sandwiches, tacos, and desserts. The kitchen closes 30 minutes before posted closing time. Gluten free, vegetarian, and vegan options are available upon request.
